scope: mix wotex.software.build and mix wotex.software.run inside Linux arm64 containers on both required Elixir/OTP runtimes, with the Linux ASan/UBSan native vector build

source_identity.kind: git working tree copied into each container
untracked_at_run: test/software/Dockerfile.linux (environment definition; outside software-run source identity)

environment.platform: Linux arm64 (Docker Desktop VM on macOS arm64)
environment.container: docker run --rm --cpus 4 --memory 6g; read-only mounts of the wotex, wotex-runtime and wotex-coap checkouts; rsync to /work/src excluding _build, deps, cover, doc, docs/tasks/local and archives; WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 TMPDIR=/work/tmp

defect_found.observed: mix wotex.software.build failed with extraction_failed because OTP 27.3.4.15 erl_tar rejects libcoap's examples/contiki/coap_config.h -> ../../coap_config.h.contiki link as unsafe_symlink
defect_found.fixed_by: commit d8d856f extracts only validated files and directories through erl_tar and creates the two digest-bound links explicitly

assertions: Both lanes build the pinned libcoap, the production helper, the upstream coap-server peer and 12 native fault/vector executables; every vector compiles with ASan/UBSan and exits 0, including the production-worker exchange harness
The production helper and peer binaries are byte-identical across the two lanes
Both lanes run the 15 independent UDP/PSK/PKI tests, 10 same-stack OSCORE tests and 8 lifecycle stress tests with seed zero and 33 passes
Each software run records zero retained command groups, peer processes, UDP ports and session/context/subscription/store locks
unaccepted: The production helper used by the ExUnit OSCORE and stress cases is not itself sanitizer-instrumented in this lane; the separately sanitized helper remains the test/native/Dockerfile evidence
Linux x86_64, other distributions and other toolchains
Pending-operation owner loss, authenticated duplicate/stale and replay injection, Port-mailbox sampling and the native-v1 corpus
Clean committed-source archive and out-of-tree package gates on both runtimes
